d:
The Nets defeated the Hornets, 114-104 tonight in Brooklyn. Michael Porter Jr. finished with a team-high 26 points along with 10 rebounds and 4 three pointers for the Nets, while Julius Randle tallied 22 points, 4 assists and 3 rebounds in the game. Naz Reid recorded 28 points, 9 rebounds and 2 assists. The Nets improve their record to 2-6 with the win, while the Hornets fall to 3-6 for the season.
